svg.title: tree-sitter-lilypond
svg.desc: tree-sitter-lilypond: A Tree-sitter grammar for LilyPond, written from scratch for Swara release v0.1.0, MIT, JavaScript, 23 commits. The panel shows \relative c' { c4 d e f | g1 } and its parse tree: source_file holds a command, a note and sequential_music, whose six children are five notes and a bar check.

g.text: A Tree-sitter grammar for LilyPond, written from scratch
